annotations.text:
Option A — Console — chosen, and now the build spec. Every Lessons Hardening row, calibration, parked, cast, provenance. Real data; every token value lifted from arcane-ui's theme.css, and the ramp names match its real ramp (its --ink-40 is #6c8aac; #4f6a8a is --ink-30, used here only for decorative rules).

The per-row emoji is gone (ARC-043, shipped in arcane-cli v0.36.0). The mark derives from category alone: eight inline SVG symbols referenced by <use>, coloured by the row's own --cat-* token, aria-hidden with the pill carrying the meaning. ~2 KB for all eight. Replace them from arcane-ui's icon set if there is one — keyed by category, so it is a template-only change.

LIGHT is in scope, and is the print master (operator, 2026-09-03: the same report must print).

arcane-ui's light block retunes only --bg and --ink, never --signal-* or --accent, so the eight light --cat-* values here are authored and measured on --bg-1 #e4eaef; every one clears 4.5:1 (worst: platform 4.73).

--ink-50 and --ink-40 are the FIXED values (#435b78 / #496482). As shipped they measured 4.36:1 and 3.04:1 and failed AA across the product, not just here — fix committed on arcane-ui's fix/light-scheme-ink-ramp-contrast branch, not yet pushed. Signal and accent are still unfixed and are the whole of the residual light risk.

Export PDF paginates this artboard (print: flow); @media print drops fills and glows and appends link URLs.
The two directions not chosen, kept for the record. B — Briefing: document rhythm, hairline rules, larger reading type. C — Dispatch: verdict and calibration first, ledger demoted to 'the record'.

The parked list reads 9 items, not 8. Designing against real data caught three generator bugs: one parked item was silently dropped, wrapped reasons were cut mid-sentence, and ledger claims were truncated mid-word. All three are fixed in arcane-cli v0.36.0 and this artboard shows the corrected output — so it can be trusted as the spec.
